name: selfbound-game
description: SELFBOUND TypeScript Canvas game with a minimal backend boundary

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm run serve:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-tests/tests/logic.test.js dist-tests/tests/gameplay.test.js dist-tests/tests/ai-coach.test.js dist-tests/tests/ai-coach-backend.test.js dist-tests/tests/ai-coach-gemini.test.js dist-tests/tests/training-plan.test.js dist-tests/tests/training-plan-backend.test.js dist-tests/tests/training-plan-gemini.test.js
